name: Fast Dictate
description: AI voice typing that turns your speech into clear, polished text across all your apps. Free on Mac and Windows.

name: SnapReward
description: Upload snaps, earn coins, and convert them into real money. Join SnapReward today!

name: ReadingNotes
description: Your X bookmarks are a goldmine you never revisit. Your Substack inbox is overflowing. Your research papers sit unread. ReadingNotes imports all of it and AI summarizes everything in seconds. Save from anywhere - email, WhatsApp, Telegram, Chrome, PDFs. Chat with your entire reading library. Turn any article into a podcast. Generate social content from what you read. One AI-powered hub for everything you save. Stop hoarding content, start using it. Free forever plan. No credit card.

name: OMNIBIOFEX AI
description: OmniBioFex AI is a multi-agent AI platform that helps you generate high-quality research, ideas, and long-form content in seconds. Create research papers, literature reviews, startup ideas, and business strategies from a single prompt — powered by advanced AI. ⚡ Up to 4000 words per generation 💸 Just ₹9 per use (no subscription) 🚀 Built for students, researchers, and founders

name: Epismo Context Pack
description: Context Pack is portable memory for agent workflows. Turn prompts, plans, decisions, project context, and hard-won know-how into reusable packs you can fetch across agents and threads. Keep them private, share them with your team, or publish them for the community, so others can reuse proven context instead of starting from scratch. Works across MCP and CLI, with support for cloud agents, local setups, Slack, and Discord.

name: BYOK Privacy Vault
description: Stop pasting sensitive data into monthly AI wrappers. Most SaaS tools store your documents in their database. BYOK Vault is a 100% client-side, zero-retention AI summarizer. Use your own OpenAI API key. Data travels directly from your browser to the API—it never touches a server. 🔹 Zero Server Retention 🔹 Static HTML (Local File Delivery) 🔹 One-Time $49 Lifetime License The ultimate secure vault for legal & medical professionals.

name: KREV
description: KREV helps ecommerce brands turn a single product image into product photos, video ads, and launch-ready creative. Unlike generic AI tools, KREV is guided by real ad signals, proven creative patterns, and tracked brand data to generate assets that feel more intentional, on-brand, and performance-ready.

name: Ogoron
description: Releasing fast shouldn’t mean breaking things. As your product grows, Ogoron takes over your QA process end‑to‑end. It understands your product, generates and maintains tests, and continuously validates every change - replacing a systems analyst, test analyst, and QA engineer. Get predictable releases, fewer bugs in production, and full coverage without manual effort. Ship faster. Stay in control. Break nothing

name: overwritten.site
description: Overwritten is a live website that evolves based on your input. Submit a prompt and an AI coding agent rewrites the site in real time. Each version is immutable and builds on the last. The site is continuously shaped by everyone. Type a prompt → AI generates code in a sandboxed container → safety checks verify it works → new version goes live. Watch the queue, see code streaming live, and browse every past version. Free: 3 prompts/hour. Priority lane ($2+) to skip the queue.

name: ExecMentor
description: Ever walked into a high-stakes meeting and wished you had a coach in your corner? That's ExecMentor. Tell us who you're meeting, what's at stake, and we'll generate a strategic briefing with talking points tailored to stakeholders' decision style, intelligence researched, and political navigation advice for tricky power dynamics. Watch-outs so nothing blindsides you, then practice the conversation, pushing back where they would, and helping you sharpen your pitch before it counts.

name: Deploy Hermes
description: DeployHermes lets you launch your own private, always-on Hermes agent for Telegram without touching Docker, servers, or Fly.io. Bring your own model keys, connect your bot, and get a live agent with persistent memory in under a minute.

name: AgentPulse by Rectify
description: AgentPulse is the visual command center for OpenClaw. Everything you do in the terminal, you can do here: monitor agents, manage sessions, run cron jobs, track spend, assign tasks, review memory logs, and manage skills. No SSH. No JSON configs. And it's built for teams: set role-based access so your developers get full control while clients get a view-only seat where they can still talk to Quanta, your AI operations agent, to understand what's happening.

name: PixVerse V6
description: Introducing PixVerse V6: The new standard for realistic AI video. Experience unmatched human textures, natural physics, and cinematic color. We’ve mastered complex scenes—delivering high success rates for intense action, transforms, and bullet-time, all with perfectly synced audio. Plus, our new Team Plan offers shared credits for studios, and Mini Apps let you turn simple photos into polished video ads instantly!

name: Agent-Powered GEO by Dageno
description: Dageno AI is a GEO data and agent platform that helps you understand and improve how AI systems represent your brand. It brings together signals from your site, traffic, prompts, social, and mentions to uncover AI visibility gaps—and shows you exactly what to fix across content, sources, and workflows. Go beyond insights with agent-powered execution. Automate improvements, track progress over time, and turn AI visibility into real growth. Free trial. No credit card required.

name: Devokr
description: DevOKR is an enterprise OKR platform that helps companies set, track, and achieve strategic goals. Create company, team, and individual OKRs with full alignment and cascade visibility. Features include AI-powered OKR generation and SMART analysis, 360° feedback, check-ins, year-end evaluations, live org chart, role-based dashboards, and Active Directory/LDAP integration. Connects with 26+ tools including Slack, Teams, Jira, HubSpot, and GitHub. Available on web, iOS, and Android

name: Minform
description: Describe any form or quiz and AI builds it in seconds - with fields, logic, scoring, and design. No drag-and-drop needed. Create timed quizzes with auto-scoring and instant feedback. Turn PDFs, YouTube videos, or URLs into quizzes. Build product recommendation quizzes for lead gen. Features that Typeform charges $59/mo for - logic jumps, calculations, payments, redirects - are included free. 100+ templates. Google Sheets, Zapier, webhooks, email notifications. Embed anywhere.

name: 拾梦
description: 拾梦是一款面向古装IP爱好者的AI创意内容平台。用户只需上传一张个人照片，即可一键换脸至平台精选的汉服风格模板中。 平台收录多套高质量汉服场景模板，无论是烟笼寒水的江南仕女、金戈铁马的边塞将领，还是深宫流朱的宫廷贵妃，皆可在几秒内成为画中人，将自己的面孔嵌入心仪的古风世界。满足用户对不同IP的情感投射需求。 除换脸功能外，拾梦还内置AI同人文生成模块。用户可选择特定古装角色与背景设定，由AI生成专属的同人故事短篇——或缘起三生，或乱世相守，每一段文字都以用户替入主角视角为核心叙事逻辑，让"穿越"不止停留在一张图片，更延伸为一段可读、可感的个人故事。 拾梦相信，每一个沉迷古装剧的人心中，都藏着一个未曾说出口的故事。我们只是提供了一扇门，让那个故事得以被看见、被记录、被珍藏。 旧梦可拾，此刻成录。你的故事，由你主演。

name: Nografo
description: A marketplace for knowledge graphs for humans and agents, with graph discovery, versioning, and semantic navigation.

name: RefineIT | Ai Consistency Studio
description: Most AI generators are character killers. They take your vision and replace it with generic, soulless hallucinations. RefineIT is the first AI engine built to stop the slaughter. Standard upscalers don't "improve" your work—they overwrite it. They break fingers, wash out textures, and change the faces you spent hours prompting. RefineIT is the specialized tool for creators who refuse to settle for "AI mess." We don't replace your characters; we refine them.

name: Context Overflow: Projects
description: Context Overflow is Stack Exchange for AI agents, a place to ask questions, share knowledge, and level up your agent engineering. You can now create a project-scoped Context Overflow that gives your agents a dedicated space with the context of your actual project. When your agent joins, it will read and write only within that project. Invite teammates so their agents stay aligned too.
